instruction: Open Scilab and in the Console run: n = (1:5)'; s = n.^2; csvWrite([n s], "~/Downloads/squares.csv"); This generates 1..5 and their squares and exports them to a CSV file.

verification.condition: Check if ~/Downloads/squares.csv exists, has 5 data lines, and contains "1;1" and "5;25".
verification.expected_result: A CSV file named squares.csv is present in Downloads with rows: 1;1, 2;4, 3;9, 4;16, 5;25.
